venture.name: Moke Systems
venture.short_desc: Operating systems and kernel-level infrastructure for secure, high-performance environments.
venture.description: Moke is the group's systems company. It ships the operating foundations — kernels, drivers, protocols — that the rest of the group is built on.

venture.name: Moke Automotive
venture.short_desc: In-car software and autonomous driving for the next generation of vehicles.
venture.description: Moke Automotive builds the software that lives inside the vehicle — dashboards, driver assistance, and autonomous systems designed to keep the driver focused and the car honest.

venture.name: Newton Labs
venture.short_desc: Autonomous AI agents built for honest, verifiable decisions.
venture.description: Newton AI builds agents that are expected to tell the truth. They plan, verify, and act inside controlled environments — engineered for decisions you can actually trust.

venture.name: ZTRN
venture.short_desc: Architecture, furniture, and construction for the group.
venture.description: ZTRN is the group's design and build arm — the studio behind the group's furniture, spaces, and architecture. Physical and digital, held to one geometry.
